people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: By a prophet Yahweh brought Israel up out of Egypt, and by a prophet he was preserved.
translations.bsb: But by a prophet the LORD brought Israel out of Egypt, and by a prophet he was preserved.
translations.kjv: And by a prophet the LORD brought Israel out of Egypt, and by a prophet was he preserved.
translations.asv: And by a prophet Jehovah brought Israel up out of Egypt, and by a prophet was he preserved.
